lines.text: Fin-demo Health membership forms. Scanned, photographed, filled in by hand, boxes ticked by hand. Here's how Progress Agentic RAG turns them into structured data you can trust.

It starts with a real sample pack. Clean scans. A missing page. Pages out of order. Faded blue ink. Word files. Phone photos. And one scanner batch with seven applicants in a single twenty-eight page file.

The hard page is the medical disclosure. A body diagram, two columns, and the checkboxes sit left of some labels and right of others. Ticked by hand. Run it through OCR alone and the ticks are gone before any question is asked.
Step one. The file is split into pages, and each page goes into the Knowledge Box as its own resource. The model only ever looks at one page at a time.
Step two. Each page is identified from its printed headings. When the headings don't read, like on a phone photo, a vision model names the page from the image instead.

Step three. One structured ask per page. It carries a schema written for that page, and the page image travels with the question. So the checkboxes come back ticked or not, read from the pixels, not from text.

Step four. The pages regroup into one application by the ID number written on them. Then every field earns its confidence score: the South African ID checksum, the date of birth and gender encoded in that ID, whether the ID agrees across the pages, and the format of every date, email and cell number. Anything under seventy percent goes on a review list.
Step five. Every page resource is deleted from the Knowledge Box, and the deletion is verified. The pages are not kept. What persists is the structured data the schema asked for.
And here's what comes back. The schema, filled in. A confidence on every field. Four pages found, none missing. One JSON document, ready for whatever system comes next.

It's measured, not assumed. Five vision models on the same four pages score ninety-two to ninety-nine percent, and the top three read every checkbox right. Any of the seventy-five models on the account can be compared on the same scan, in one click.

And the messy ones hold up. The missing page is flagged. The shuffled scan is reassembled. Word files convert. Phone photos read, with the doubtful fields flagged. And the twenty-eight page scanner batch comes back as one application per applicant.
Submit the document. Get structured JSON back, with a confidence score on every field. Keep none of the pages. Powered by Progress Agentic RAG.
